key_insight: The paper reframes reinforcement learning for Masked Diffusion Language Models as a two-stage policy over both token generation and position remasking, enabling a more complete policy gradient objective.
engineering_relevance: This provides a practical route to improve reasoning and code generation in diffusion-based language models without relying on intractable log-likelihood estimation.
method: Model MDLM generation as a two-stage action MDP: token placement plus remasking decisions.
Decompose the policy gradient into a token term and a masking term.
Optimize both terms jointly to better match the full generation process.
evidence_signal: The approach reports strong benchmark performance in the abstract, including 87.1% on GSM8K and 53.4% on MBPP.
watch_item: Training may be more complex than token-only methods because the masking policy must be learned and optimized stably alongside token predictions.
paper_title: Mask-Aware Policy Gradients for Diffusion Language Models
